feature.title: Shared types package with branded types

acceptance_criteria.details: New package in packages/types with proper workspace config

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC2: Branded ID types prevent mixing
acceptance_criteria.details: FeatureId, ProjectId, SessionId are nominally typed

acceptance_criteria.criterion: AC3: Status enums defined with Zod
acceptance_criteria.details: FEATURE_STATUS, SESSION_STATUS as const objects with z.enum schemas

discoveries.discovery: Zod .brand<>() creates compile-time type safety for primitive IDs
discoveries.context: Structurally identical string IDs can be accidentally swapped without branded types
discoveries.lesson: Use z.string().brand<'TypeName'>() for all domain IDs

discoveries.discovery: Status enums work best as const objects with derived types
discoveries.context: Need both runtime values and TypeScript types
discoveries.lesson: const STATUS = {...} as const; type Status = typeof STATUS[keyof typeof STATUS];
discoveries.code_pattern:
const STATUS = { ACTIVE: 'active' } as const;
type Status = (typeof STATUS)[keyof typeof STATUS];

what_worked: Branded types prevent ID mixing at compile time
Workspace package allows shared types across apps
what_could_improve: Add regex validation to branded ID types (F001 format)

recommendations.recommendation: Use branded types for all domain IDs
recommendations.rationale: Prevents bugs from passing wrong ID type to functions
